propositions: The inbound link differ is ADD-only by design and construction, emitting only link additions while never removing links deleted on the peer side.
A link deleted in Jira remains present on the local ticket forever because the inbound differ lacks a removal path while the outbound direction has one.
The apply layer silently discards non-add link records via `action != 'add': continue` check, making any removal emit from the differ unreachable.

Correctly inferring peer deletion from local presence requires distinguishing it from unobserved links, which existing managed_refs cannot do; the design was deferred as not commonly handled in the ecosystem.
The shipped semantics are local-wins-and-restore: peer-deleted links are re-added on next pass, convergent and safe, identical on both Cloud and DC backends.
